stage: P2 bounded target screening, not final held-out evaluation
hardware: Existing CV2_GPU A100 runtime, JAX float64
prior: N(0,I) in each configured coordinate system; no claim these are linear reparameterizations of one posterior
synthetic_scope: Paired base design and label uniforms. Feature covariance condition number is a design input; posterior Hessian condition number is measured. Signal changes do not isolate third derivatives alone.

primary_grid.h_rule: h=c/L_P; symmetric anchor H inverse with frozen 1e-10 ridge, full L_P effectively 1; actual values saved

focused_controls: identity SGLD/CV1/CV2 c=.05; fixed-diagonal CV1/CV2 c=.1 retaining full CV2 correction; Li-SGLD alpha=.9 c=.01 and alpha=.99 c=.04; Li-CV1/CV2 alpha=.99 c=.01. No full factorial expansion.
li: raw minibatch mean likelihood gradient, excludes prior and CV correction; v0=0; v=alpha v+(1-alpha)raw^2; D=1/(1e-5+sqrt(v)); drift and noise both scaled; adaptive correction omitted, empirical baseline only. Initial h calibration uses fixed pilot minibatch and first-update D curvature; no heldout calibration.
sampling: Each independent replica starts at common mode. Independent replica/iteration/purpose JAX streams. Uniform without-replacement batches via Floyd exact-subset algorithm, validated before pilot seeds.
failure: Permanent nonfinite or standardized radius>100 sqrt(d); any failed replica invalidates complete ensemble accuracy after failure. No successful-replica-only estimates.
reference: Two independent full-data Metropolis HMC pools; four chains each; 256 warmup +1024 retained; anchor whitening; eight leapfrog steps, jitter and warmup-only adaptation; max Rhat<1.01, min bulk/tail ESS>=400, acceptance>.5, no energy divergences; pair max mean-MCSE z<4, relative covariance difference<.2. Failure gates all posterior accuracy rankings.
accuracy: Pilot replica SW2 in fixed symmetric sqrt(anchor posterior Hessian) coordinates, 128 frozen projections, 64 endpoints vs256 reference draws; two references, independent reference floor. Ergodic functional variance NRMSE. No absolute SW2 certification or frontier conclusion until independent bootstrap audit is reviewed and final P2 protocol frozen.
gradient_MSE: 24 common posterior locations, 32 paired minibatches each, n32, SGLD/CV1/CV2; arithmetic mean and median raw squared error plus whitened error. Reference quality flag retained.
cost: Primary wall-clock only, setup-inclusive; anchor + actual cache/metric/state setup + sampling; cold compile and compiled-code reuse views separately. Functionals, scoring, validation and reference work separate research costs. No FLOPs extension.
selection_rule: Report every candidate and failure. Eligibility requires reliable references and feasible setup/step time. Consider reproducible CV1-ULA gap, CV2 gradient MSE improvement and time tradeoff jointly; do not select solely largest gap. Final main-target selection and numeric grids get separate freeze before selection/heldout runs.
bank_source: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/222/bank%2Bmarketing.zip; bank-full.csv, all45211 rows; continuous standardized; categorical reference levels dropped; intercept; duration included; labels yes=1. Dataset and transformed-data SHA256 recorded before sampler evaluation.
bootstrap_audit: Separate Gaussian equal-distribution finite-cloud diagnostic: R128/reference256,d10,32 projections,24 trials,199 bootstrap replicates,512 independent clouds for conditional mean estimate. Reports shift and empirical interval inclusion; no P1 rewrite and no data-driven P2 CI replacement.
next_gate: Review screening and SW2 audit, freeze actual target/LP/h/reference/thresholds and selection budget; final heldout not authorized by this pilot runner.
